minutes.headline: School Committee approved incoming superintendent Dr. Fortuna's three-year contract by roll-call vote.
minutes.summary: The committee announced Dr. Jodie Fortuna's appointment as incoming superintendent, went into executive session, then voted by roll call to approve her contract terms. The rest of the meeting was the first reading of a revised student transportation (bus) fee policy, covering fee tiers, waivers, and the portal-to-portal distance definition.

what_happened.line: The committee voted 4-0 by roll call to approve incoming superintendent Dr. Fortuna's three-year contract.
The contract adds an annual raise and reimbursement for a professional association membership, and was described as similar to the outgoing superintendent's terms.
The committee gave a first reading to a revised student transportation fee policy, withdrawing a motion to waive the reading so the full policy was read aloud.
Staff agreed to send the bus fee policy to families before the following Tuesday for feedback and to follow up with families who have not submitted transportation forms.

why_it_matters: The superintendent's contract sets salary, term and benefits for the district's top administrator, a recurring line in the school budget.
The bus fee policy sets what families pay for transportation, including tiers for reduced-lunch status and multiple children, and is not yet final.
